summary: KNOT Offshore Partners LP filed a routine Form 6-K containing its unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the quarter and six months ended June 30, 2026, covering time-charter and bareboat revenues, related-party balances with Knutsen NYK Offshore Tankers AS and KNOT Management, SOFR-linked debt disclosures, and unit-ownership detail. No transaction, offer, solicitation, board recommendation, or structural event is disclosed. The filing is an ordinary periodic report by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a US quarterly report, and presents no special-situation angle for risk arbitrage.
